No internal components shown. No BIOS screen, system information, or sticker visible. Cannot verify CPU, RAM, or storage from photos alone.
Screen is off in all photos. No operating system visible. Cannot confirm Windows 11 or any OS.
No evidence of UK origin in photos. No power adapter, no regional stickers, no serial number or label indicating country of use.
No accessories shown. No power adapter, pen, or other accessories visible. Cannot confirm 'all parts' are included.
